name: short_progression_input

name: harman_fourier_input
header:

    ∃ αp : ℝ, 0 < αp ∧ αp < 2.9 ∧
      ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ X : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, X ≤ x →

name: bhp_endpoint_lower
header:
theorem bhp_endpoint_lower (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 11 / 20 < σ) (hσ1 : σ < 1) :
    ∃ Y : ℝ, 1 < Y ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, Y ≤ y → ∀ h : ℝ,
      y ^ σ ≤ h → h ≤ y / Real.log y → ∀ d c : ℕ,
      1 ≤ d → (d : ℝ) ≤ Real.log y ^ (2 : ℕ) → Nat.Coprime c d →
      0.995 * h / (d.totient * Real.log y) ≤
        ∑ n ∈ (ints (y - h) y).filter (fun n => n ≡ c [MOD d]), ρ n

name: harman_reference_mean

name: prime_moment_upper
header:
theorem prime_moment_upper (x : ℝ) (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) :
    (∫ α in minorDomain x, starNorm x α * ‖primeSeries x α‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (Real.sqrt (Real.pi / 2) * (0.77962 + 3.5776e-4)) *
        (x ^ 2 / LeanLab.Helfgott2013.κ)

name: prime_supported_large_sieve_finset
header:
theorem prime_supported_large_sieve_finset (A : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (x δ Q₀ : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 1 ≤ δ) (hQ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀)
    (hsize : (20000 * Q₀) ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ))
    (hpower : 2 * Q₀ ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt (x / (2 * δ))) ^ (0.6 : ℝ))
    (hsupport : ∀ n ∈ A, ¬n.Prime ∨ (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x → a n = 0) :
    (∫ α in majorArcs x δ Q₀ ∩ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖∑ n ∈ A, a n * LeanLab.Ternary.MMS.e ((n : ℝ) * α)‖ ^ 2) ≤
      ((Real.log (2 * Q₀) + 1.36) /
        (Real.log (2 * Real.sqrt (x / (2 * δ))) + sieveConstant)) *
          ∑ n ∈ A, ‖a n‖ ^ 2

name: star_mass_error
header:
theorem star_mass_error (x : ℝ) (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) :
    |(∑' n : ℕ, (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) * starWeight (n / x)) -
      x * (∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), starWeight t)| ≤
      1.9075e-8 * x / LeanLab.Helfgott2013.κ

name: nonprime_coeff_square_upper
header:
theorem nonprime_coeff_square_upper (x : ℝ) (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, if ¬n.Prime then
      ‖((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (LeanLab.HelfgottArcs.etaPlus (n / x) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
      (2.33744 * (2 + Real.log x) + 0.44937) * Real.sqrt x

name: small_index_coeff_square_upper
header:
theorem small_index_coeff_square_upper (x : ℝ) (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) :
    (∑' n : ℕ, if (n : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt x then
      ‖((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        (LeanLab.HelfgottArcs.etaPlus (n / x) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 else 0) ≤
      0.60581 * Real.sqrt x * Real.log x

name: asymmetric_popular_input
header:
theorem asymmetric_popular_input :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 → ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ),
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → A ⊆ Icc 1 N → B ⊆ Icc 1 N →
      ((popular N δ A B).card : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (min A.card B.card : ℕ) - ε * N →
      ∃ P : Finset ℕ, IsAPIn N P ∧ δ * N ≤ P.card ∧
        (1 / 2 + ε / 5) * P.card ≤ (A ∩ P).card
